tools.name: neetodesk_list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets in the workspace, newest first unless sort and order say otherwise. Filter by status (comma-separated, e.g. open,on_hold), priority, assignee, customer, tags, free-text query or a time window. Returns tickets plus pagination. API: GET /tickets.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket with its status, priority, group, assignee, customer, tags, custom fields and timestamps. API: GET /tickets/{ticket_id}.

tools.name: neetodesk_list_ticket_comments
tools.description: List the comments (replies and internal notes) on one ticket, oldest first. API: GET /tickets/{ticket_id}/comments.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_ticket_comment
tools.description: Get one comment on a ticket by its id. API: GET /tickets/{ticket_id}/comments/{comment_id}.

tools.name: neetodesk_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers in the workspace, oldest first. Optionally filter by email. API: GET /customers.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer's name, email and phone numbers. API: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: neetodesk_list_team_members
tools.description: List the agents (team members) in the workspace. Optionally filter by email. API: GET /team-members.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_team_member
tools.description: Get one team member's details, role and groups. API: GET /team-members/{team_member_id}.

tools.name: neetodesk_list_ticket_fields
tools.description: List the custom ticket fields in the workspace, in display order. API: GET /fields.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_ticket_volume_report
tools.description: Ticket volume for a time window: counts by status and the change against the previous period. API: GET /reports/tickets.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_ticket_time_series
tools.description: Daily counts of new and closed tickets for a time window, for charting. API: GET /reports/ticket-time-series.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_agent_performance_report
tools.description: Per-agent response time, resolution time and ticket counts for a time window, with the previous period for comparison. API: GET /reports/agents.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_team_performance_report
tools.description: Per-team (group) response time, resolution time and ticket counts for a time window, with the previous period for comparison. API: GET /reports/groups.

tools.name: neetodesk_get_customer_satisfaction_report
tools.description: Customer satisfaction survey results for a time window: the response count for each rating option. API: GET /reports/surveys.

tools.name: neetodesk_update_ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's status, priority, group, assignee, due date or tags. tags replaces every tag, so use add_tags or remove_tags to change some tags only; do not combine tags with them. Status trash, spam and moved are refused here: use the NeetoDesk app for those. API: PUT /tickets/{ticket_id}.

tools.name: neetodesk_add_internal_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a ticket. Agents see it; the customer does not receive it by email. This server posts notes only, never customer replies. API: POST /tickets/{ticket_id}/comments with comment_type note.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: neetodesk_list_tickets, neetodesk_get_ticket, neetodesk_list_ticket_comments, neetodesk_get_ticket_comment, neetodesk_list_customers, neetodesk_get_customer, neetodesk_list_team_members, neetodesk_list_ticket_fields, neetodesk_get_ticket_volume_report, neetodesk_get_ticket_time_series, neetodesk_get_agent_performance_report, neetodesk_get_team_performance_report, neetodesk_add_internal_note · Public sink: neetodesk_list_customers, neetodesk_get_customer, neetodesk_list_team_members, neetodesk_add_internal_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: neetodesk_list_tickets, neetodesk_get_ticket, neetodesk_list_ticket_comments, neetodesk_get_ticket_comment, neetodesk_list_customers, neetodesk_get_customer, neetodesk_list_team_members, neetodesk_list_ticket_fields, neetodesk_get_ticket_volume_report, neetodesk_get_ticket_time_series, neetodesk_get_agent_performance_report, neetodesk_get_team_performance_report, neetodesk_add_internal_note · Public sink: neetodesk_list_customers, neetodesk_get_customer, neetodesk_list_team_members, neetodesk_add_internal_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
